sources.title: KV cache quantization: what FP8/INT8 K and V actually buy you, and ...
sources.snippet: FP8 and INT8 KV caches cut attention state ~50%, but they shift the target model's logit distribution — and that can quietly halve the gains from speculative decoding. vLLM v0.22.1 tour.
